verified_findings.element: Adresse de livraison — autocomplete inline (order type Livraison)
verified_findings.title: Delivery address autocomplete silently produces zero suggestions when Google Maps JS SDK is not loaded
verified_findings.grep_evidence: Read PosComponent.vue:4257-4277 at HEAD 04603fa87: _getDeliveryAcService() returns null when window.google.maps.places absent; _fetchDeliverySuggestions then runs `if (!svc) { this.deliveryInline.suggestions = []; return; }` with NO user-visible message. deliveryGeocodeError notice (template 732-736, setter 4221) fires ONLY in the geocode-failure SELECT path, never in the SDK-absent autocomplete path. Confirmed input remains reactive (v-model, debounce setTimeout line 4244) and order completion still works manually. Not an axios endpoint (Google Maps Places JS SDK), so an axios sweep finds nothing. NOT dead/broken — order can be completed via manual entry.
verified_findings.recommendation: When _getDeliveryAcService() returns null in _fetchDeliverySuggestions, set a one-line hint (e.g. reuse deliveryGeocodeError or a 'saisie manuelle' notice) instead of a silent empty array, so the cashier knows autocomplete is unavailable rather than waiting for a dropdown that will never appear.
